description: This pie chart illustrates the "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)," displaying a total of three distinct categories. The chart does not utilize a separate legend; rather, bolded text labels are positioned just outside their corresponding segments. The largest segment, colored green and labeled "LOCAL," constitutes the vast majority of the distribution, though it lacks an explicit percentage label. The remaining two segments are visually emphasized by being exploded, or slightly offset, from the main body of the pie. These consist of a red slice labeled "LLM" containing an internal text label of 3.9%, and a smaller blue slice labeled "EDGE_P2P" with an internal label of 1.6%. Visually, the segments appear to be arranged in descending order of size, starting with the dominant green slice, followed by the red slice, and concluding with the smallest blue slice.
